about_the_game:
In 'To Grant A Wish' you play as a Minor Deity, whose presence has been fading due to a lack of worship. One day, you receive an offering on your shrine that grants you more power than you have had in a century, and you set out, determined to grant their wish. 

Unfortunately, this isn't quite so simple as it seems... 

The Player Character: Zephyr (Name Changeable)

Minor Deity of the Breeze. The player character is kind and playful, if a bit out of touch with society.

There are three versions, each with three different skin tone options, for a total of 9 possible MC's.

The Characters:

Bells: (They/Them)

Bells VA: Brandon P Jenkins and Kirsty Woolven

A cheerful and friendly traveller who makes their living as a dancer. They are almost never seen without their curious mouse companion Chimes. They seem perfectly happy, so what has lead to them making a wish at your shrine?

Chimes

Chimes VA: Noah Belachew 

Leo/Sam: (Leo: He/Him and Sam: She/Her.)

Leo VA: Nicholas Contreras + Sam VA: Whitney Holland

A tired and over-worked older sibling who is trying their best for their little brother. What has got them so stressed? And perhaps more importantly, is there anything you can do to help?Oscar

Oscar VA: Allison Man

The excitable younger brother of Leo/Sam. He is enraptured by pirates, especially the brave Captain Fin. What's got him so concerned about his older brother that he makes a wish at your shrine?

Lorelei/Callen: (Lorelei: (She/Her) and Callen: He/Him)

Lorelei VA: EvelynnDE and Callen VA: Marlon Dance-Hooi

A responsible and hard-working young person who claims that they won't allow anyone to dictate their fate anymore. What were they praying for then, when they visited your shrine?

Recommended Route Order:

There is no strict route order, however I personally recommend Bells (Purple Bracelet) -> Lorelei/Callen (Fur Tuft Necklace)  -> Leo/Sam (Shark Pirate Toy) as certain elements might be more meaningful if you have seen certain parts of the other routes.

Features:

  • Selectable appearance and deity pronouns for the player character (God/Goddess/Deity).

  • Custom name for the player character (voiced names below).

  • 150k words for an estimated 12-15 hours of playtime.

  • Over ten pursuable characters (not including alternate versions such as Leo/Sam or Lorelei/Callen), with more to come.

  • Over 75+ CG's.

  • A range of adorable dog-themed logo screens, picked randomly when you launch the game.

Voiced Names:

Due to the kind support of the Kickstarter backers, the following names are voiced in the game :

  • Zephyr 

  •  Aura 

  •  Astra 

  •  Vashka 

  •  Janna 

  •  Clementine 

  •  Josh 

  •  Jasmine (can also be spelt Jasmin) 

  •  Elaine 

  •  Magnus

  • Mahina

  • Aelin (can also be spelled: Aylin, or Alin) 

  • Furry

Some specific characters will also voice the following names: 

  •  Milo 

  •  Xochi

content_descriptors.notes:
Player character makes reference to/plans to grant a wish knowing that it will kill them. In bad endings they follow up on this plan.

Character death in bad endings. 

References to grief. Non-graphic violence.

Mentions of past assault/being chased by a mob including parental figures.

Attempted kidnapping/ attempted forced marriage.

Magically enforced servitude.

Implied and referenced murder. 

On-screen animal death. Off-screen description of animal death. 

Referenced ableism.
